first_public_date_evidence: The earliest verified exact online appearance date among the cited foundational sources is the SIAM publisher history for Caro–West–Yuster: Published online 1 August 2006. The 2000 print issue gives no exact day; that journal year is not substituted for the online date.
integrity_statement: Definitions, proof obligations and two deterministic verification programs are included. Numerical facts were recomputed from the stated graph adjacency, not copied from previous results. External independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite comparison of two 16-vertex strongly regular graphs, not a general theorem for all cospectral graphs. Complete exchange and metric counts are established by exhaustive finite enumeration with two separate implementations; no infinite-size extrapolation is made. An equivalent result in unindexed literature cannot be ruled out, and a complete copy of a related 2013 total-domination article could not be inspected.
title: Connected-backbone exchange thresholds distinguish the Shrikhande and rook graphs
